gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing by the side of the nullah opposite to Lam Uk Tsuen and running in a south-easterly direction for about 380 metres where it terminates at its junction with TAK YIP STREET as shown coloured pink and hatched black on Plan No. LD/YL/R4.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由林屋村對面之防洪渠起，向東南伸展約三百八十米，至與德業街交界處終止。在 LD/YL/R4 號圖則上以粉紅色間以黑斜綫標明。

gazette_location.description_raw_en: Street commencing at its junction with HONG YIP STREET and running in a north-easterly direction for about 47 metres; it then turns to run in a north-westerly direction for about 263 metres before it turns further to run in a south-westerly direction for about 105 metres where it terminates at its other junction with HONG YIP STREET as shown coloured pink and cross-hatched black on Plan No. LD/YL/R4.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此街由與康業街交界處起，向東北伸展約四十七米，然後轉向西北伸展約二百六十三米，再轉向西南伸展約一百○五米，至與康業街交界處終止。在 LD/YL/R4 號圖則上以粉紅色間以交錯黑斜綫標明。
